title: Service reference
description: Registration of an in-house service. One file per service under schemas/service-references/.

name.description: Service name as referenced by allowed_responses.service in prompt files.

spiffe.description: Expected SPIFFE URI of the service. Mesh authz keys on this identity.

source_digest.description: OCI digest of the service's mcp-schema.json artifact. Bundle builder pulls + verifies + embeds at this digest.
